description: Lists every long weekend in a country for a year: the ones that need no leave, and the ones that one or two days of leave create by joining a public holiday to a weekend ("bridge days"). Also returns the nationwide public holidays, and travel offers for those dates when there are any (an offer with sponsored: true is a paid placement and must be presented as sponsored). Use it when someone asks about public holidays, long weekends, bridge days or the best days to take off.

country.description: Country where the person works: a 2-letter code (DE) or the English name (Germany).

year.description: Calendar year. Defaults to the current year.

name: find_long_weekends

long_weekends.description: Every long weekend of the year, in date order.

days_off.description: Days off in a row, counting weekends and public holidays.

leave_dates.description: The working days to request as leave, YYYY-MM-DD.

leave_days.description: Days of leave this break costs. 0 means none.

offers.description: Travel offers for these dates, in the order to show them.

business.description: The travel business making the offer.

end.description: Last day the offer is valid for, YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: "Sponsored" or "Partner offer": the label to show.

price_from.description: Lowest price, when the business gave one.

sponsored.description: True when the business pays for its position. Must be presented as sponsored.

start.description: First day the offer is valid for, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: Link to the offer. Use it exactly as given.

offers_note.description: How to present offers. Present only when an answer contains offers.

title: Find long weekends and bridge days
